FROM [Visits] AS [v]
INNER JOIN [Patients] AS [p] ON [v].[PatientId] = [p].[PatientId]
LEFT JOIN [ReferralPartners] AS [r] ON [v].[ReferralPartnerId] = [r].[ReferralPartnerId]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [o].[OrderId], [o].[CancellationReason], [o].[CancelledAt], [o].[CancelledByUserId], [o].[CreatedAt], [o].[Department], [o].[Discount], [o].[ParentOrderId], [o].[Price], [o].[SpecimenId], [o].[Status], [o].[TestCode], [o].[TestId], [o].[VisitId], [t].[TestId] AS [TestId0], [t].[Category], [t].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt0], [t].[DepartmentId], [t].[ExtraInfo], [t].[IsActive], [t].[IsProfile], [t].[SpecialInstructions], [t].[SpecimenTypeCode], [t].[TAT_Hours], [t].[TestCode] AS [TestCode0], [t].[TestName], [t].[UpdatedAt]
    FROM [Orders] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [Tests] AS [t] ON [o].[TestId] = [t].[TestId]
) AS [t0] ON [v].[VisitId] = [t0].[VisitId]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [i].[InvoiceId], [i].[CreatedAt], [i].[Currency], [i].[DiscountAmount], [i].[DueDate], [i].[GrossAmount], [i].[NetAmount], [i].[Status], [i].[TaxAmount], [i].[Total], [i].[VisitId], [p0].[PaymentId], [p0].[Amount], [p0].[InvoiceId] AS [InvoiceId0], [p0].[Method], [p0].[ReceiptNo], [p0].[ReceivedAt], [p0].[ReceivedByUserId]
    FROM [Invoices] AS [i]
